findings.reason: The protected app-local and Accepted native sources are the direct inclusion-exclusion solution. They calculate both rectangle areas, clamp each one-dimensional intersection length at zero, and subtract the overlap product using a fixed number of integer operations. The O(1)-time, O(1)-space implementation is clear and exact, so no candidate is justified.

The former 8/64/256 coordinate-unit tiers changed numeric magnitude without changing the fixed operation count and therefore were not honest scaling workloads. A verified bounded-domain certificate now records the eight-scalar fixed arity and proves the exact constant set of extrema, arithmetic, and clamping operations.

The inclusion-exclusion derivation and overlap proof already match the protected sources. Alternatives and geometric boundaries now use explicit required labels, and the Optimal summary names the exact clamped-overlap formula.
